findings.finding: Unscoped message ID dedup drops unrelated chat/account events
findings.proof: revalidation.filter.test.ts: drops a different chat with same message ID before classification
findings.impact: Two distinct chat messages sharing raw ID produce only one classifier call and alert.

findings.finding: Agent-subscription adapter discards actual message and conversation identity
findings.proof: revalidation.filter.test.ts: classifies duplicate inbound and actual dispatch-shaped received events twice
findings.impact: Channel+agent subscription produces two classifier calls/two sends; agent-origin chat becomes unknown.

findings.finding: Classification failure consumes in-memory dedup key without retryable work record
findings.proof: revalidation.filter.test.ts: marks failed classification seen, so redelivery does not retry it
findings.impact: Provider outage loses alert classification until dedup eviction/restart; existing boot retry covers only already-inserted positive notifications.

findings.finding: Shared DroneHost model attribution race undermines per-model cost baseline
findings.impact: Earlier model-a run completion priced/tagged model-b after overlapping resolve; risk requires different configured concurrent models.

findings.finding: Best-new-pilot ranking unsubstantiated; matcher is optional and rubric-configurable
findings.impact: No current activation/volume observed. Complaint-only gate cannot suppress arbitrary custom alert rules. Preserve as conditional experiment only.
